en-US.summary: Alexa can change personalities and moods
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask personality changer to be happy
Alexa, ask personality changer to be sassy
Alexa, tell personality changer to be annoyed
en-US.name: Personality Changer
en-US.description: This skill allows Alexa to change personalities including Happy, Sad, Annoyed, Sassy, Mad, Angry, Upset, Excited, and Neutral. Each personality comes with a matching voice tone, mood, and character.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill and ask Alexa to change to different personalities.
